interpretation: Three persistent-exploration populations at 600 seconds, each sampled into two new environments for 360 seconds. Within each environment, the same 192 sampled descendant genotypes have normal, disabled, or shuffled motor learning. Mutation is disabled and lifetime neural state starts empty; recurrent plasticity and learning-capacity costs remain. Founder references have normal learning only. These are community interventions, not independent per-creature fitness samples. Shuffled rates retain population-wide signals; singleton batches cannot be shuffled.
